description: Principal is a sysadmin on the target MSSQL instance; code execution via xp_cmdshell/OLE/CLR.

telemetry.detail: Process create where sqlservr.exe is the parent (xp_cmdshell) - a strong tell.
Logon to the SQL host during the connection.
Child processes of sqlservr.exe are a well-known execution signal; SQL audit logs capture the config changes.

prerequisite_privilege: sysadmin (or impersonable login chain) on the SQL instance
abuse_primitive: Enable and run xp_cmdshell (or OLE/CLR) for OS command execution.
notes: sqlservr.exe spawning cmd/powershell is a high-fidelity behavioural detection. Always disable xp_cmdshell/OLE/CLR after use.
